Their album Diamond Life (1984) became one of the era's best-selling albums and the best-selling debut by a British female vocalist.

The next year, she appeared in the film Absolute Beginners. The band released their third album (Stronger Than Pride) in 1988, and a fourth album (Love Deluxe) in 1992. The band reunited in 1999 and the following year, released Lovers Rock, their first album in eight years. Lovers Rock was a departure from the band's earlier jazz-inspired sounds. In 2010, the band released Soldier of Love, their sixth studio album, and toured arenas worldwide.

White released his debut studio album Blunderbuss (2012) to strong reviews and sales.
